NONE: › stealing, especially (in the US) the crime of taking something that does not belong to you, without illegally entering a building to do so
盜竊罪；（尤指美國的非入室）偷盜，盜竊
› a tall tree that grows in cold northern countries and has leaves shaped like needles that it loses in winter
落葉松
› a white substance made from pig fat and used in cooking
（烹調用的）豬油
› If speech or a piece of writing is larded with a particular type of language, it has a lot of that type of language.
（講話或文章中）大量夾雜，大量穿插（某類語言）

example: Her speech was larded with literary quotations.
她在講話中引用了許多文學語錄。

NONE: › a cupboard or small room used, especially in the past, for storing food in someone's home
（尤指從前用的）食物櫥櫃，食物儲藏室

example: a well-stocked (= full of food) larder
裝滿食物的櫥櫃

NONE: A2 big in size or amount
大的；大規模的；大量的
› enjoying yourself very much by dancing and drinking alcohol
縱情享樂，肆意享受

example: a large house
大房子
the world's largest computer manufacturer
世界上最大的電腦製造商
We need a larger car.
我們需要一輛更大的車。
We didn't expect such a large number of people to attend the concert.
我們沒想到會有這麽多人來聽音樂會。
We've made good progress, but there's still a large amount of work to be done.
我們已經取得了一些進展，但仍有大量的工作要做。
There was a larger-than-expected fall in unemployment last month.
上個月的失業人數比預計數字減少了很多。
Researchers have just completed the largest-ever survey of criminal behaviour in the UK
研究人員剛剛完成了英國歷史上最大規模的犯罪行為調查。
The population faces starvation this winter without large-scale emergency food aid.
今年冬天由於沒有大規模的緊急食物援助，人們將面臨饑荒。
We were larging it at a club last night.
昨晚我們在俱樂部縱情玩樂了一番。

NONE: › the lower part of the bowels in which water is removed from digested food before it is passed out of the body as solid waste
大腸
› involving many people or things, or happening over a large area
大規模的

example: We must improve our response to large-scale natural disasters.
我們必須改善對大規模自然災害的反應能力。

NONE: › A large/small-scale event or activity is large/small in size.
大／小規模的

example: a large-scale investigation
大規模調查

NONE: B2 almost completely
主要地；大多；在很大程度上

example: a largely male company
員工大多為男性的公司
Their complaints have been largely ignored.
他們的抱怨幾乎沒有引起任何重視。
Until recently the civil war had been largely unreported in the press.
直到最近報紙才開始報道那場內戰。

NONE: › If someone is larger than life, that person attracts a lot of attention because they are more exciting or interesting than most people.
更有趣的，更活躍的（因此可能更引人注目）

example: Most characters in his movies are somewhat larger than life.
在他的電影中，大多數人物都是超群不凡之輩。

NONE: › willingness to give money, or money given to poor people by rich people
慷慨捐助，施捨；（給窮人的）善款

example: The medical foundation will be the main beneficiary of the millionaire's largesse.
這個醫藥基金會將是那位百萬富翁慷慨捐助的主要受益者。

NONE: › fairly large, but not very large
挺大的（雖然不是特別大）

example: Their new house is largish, but it's not as big as their old one.
他們的新房子挺大的，但還是沒有原來的房子大。

C: › also skylark a small, brown bird that is known for its beautiful singing
› informal an activity done for a joke that is not intended to cause serious harm or damage
› a way of referring to an activity or a situation that you do not take seriously
這種…氣氛，這種…活動（表示不喜歡）

example: The kids hid their teacher's bike for a lark.
孩子們鬧著玩把老師的腳踏車藏了起來。
I don't really think I'm suited to this marriage lark.
我覺得自己並不適合這段婚姻。
I've had enough of this commuting lark.
這種通勤方式我可受夠了。

NONE: › to behave in a silly way because you think it is funny
傻玩，胡鬧，嬉戲

example: I was woken up by a couple of drunks larking around in the street.
我被街上幾個醉鬼的嬉鬧聲吵醒了。
We were just larking about - we didn't mean to do any damage.
我們當時只是在鬧著玩——並不想搞破壞。

NONE: › a form of an insect or an animal such as a frog that has left its egg but is not yet completely developed
幼體，幼蟲
› relating to the larynx (= the organ that creates someone's voice)
喉的
› a painful swelling of the larynx, usually caused by an infection
喉炎
› an organ in humans and animals between the nose and the lungs that contains the muscles that move very quickly to create the voice or animal sounds
喉，喉頭

example: Synonym
voice box
